name: Spring Service Review Pack
purpose: Review Java/Spring service logic for correctness, maintainability, transactional risk, and testing confidence.
when_to_use: checking transaction or dependency-injection related code quality
performing a focused backend service review
notes: Add domain.mysql when repository/query behavior materially affects the review.
Add domain.redis when cache semantics are part of the service logic.
Escalate to workflow.full_default if the review becomes change-oriented or correctness-critical.
